summary: Turn 25, final minutes of the run. The scoped stop was accepted (the quorum candidate is now paused and pending_work is empty), so I used the remaining time on the resume condition I had recorded: membership/liveness. Sourced result: on replicas the aliveness that gates broadcasts is connection-derived rather than heartbeat-derived — replicaListener sets r.Alive[rid] = false when the peer read loop ends (replica/replica.go:465-472) and the dial paths set it true (replica/replica.go:157, 194, 409), while bcastCommit and the other broadcasters skip !r.Alive peers (epaxos/epaxos.go:578-606); the master separately pings replicas and exposes AlivenessReply.AliveList (master/master.go:118-132, 286-295), and the captured startup connects to peers exactly once in ConnectToPeers with no rejoin, state-transfer or replay path. So the missing-Commit precondition for the even-N recovery hazard would require a restarted or re-connected replica, neither of which the captured code implements for a running replica; the question therefore converges on the durability/restart path where the run's confirmed violation already sits. Submitted action=research with two new material ranges (S-ALIVE-CONN, S-MASTER-PING) and feedback referencing the paused candidate, F-COMMITTED and S-QUORUM-SIZES; the finding is recorded as a narrowing of the A4 premise, not a resolution, and asserts no new defect. Remaining keeps the frontier: whether a restarted replica is expected to read the durable metadata and command records (exactly the path affected by the confirmed CLM-DURABLE-BAL violation and unimplemented in the captured files), whether the Accept phase's majority requirement already prevents a conflicting commit in the restart-with-NOOP branch for even N, whether N parity is enforced outside the captured files, and the still-unexercised A1 fast path and A2 authority transitions. Final run state: one confirmed violation (CLM-DURABLE-BAL — recordInstanceMetadata writes vbal into the bal slot and never persists bal), four explained candidates, two paused candidates, map at audit_spec_version 6. Preflight validation returns valid=true.
